translations.web: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
translations.bsb: You are also to take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf,
translations.kjv: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
translations.asv: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts of an ephah shall be in one cake.
